picks.editorial_note: NASA's formal entry into the DOE-led Genesis Mission signals a whole-of-government AI push spanning 15+ federal agencies, the broadest policy commitment of the week and a template for coordinated national AI-for-science strategy.
picks.title: NASA Joins Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI-Driven Discovery - NASA

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's role leading 13 Genesis Mission projects and partnering on 30+ more makes it one of the largest single recipients in the initiative, underscoring DOE national labs' central role in the federal AI-for-science buildout.
picks.title: Berkeley Lab to Lead 13 New Genesis Mission AI Projects

picks.editorial_note: Oak Ridge's selection to lead nine Genesis Mission projects and contribute to 32 others is among the largest awards in the program, reflecting its position as a top-tier hub for AI-supercomputing convergence.
picks.title: Department of Energy selects ORNL to lead nine Genesis Mission projects | ORNL

picks.editorial_note: Sandia leading six Genesis Mission projects and partnering on 17 more highlights the scale of DOE's bet on national labs to fuse AI, HPC, and quantum systems for scientific discovery.
picks.title: Sandia selected to lead six Genesis Mission projects, partner on 17 others

picks.editorial_note: CuspAI's £330 million raise at a £2 billion valuation, with an Imperial College scientist as Chief Scientific Officer, is the largest single financial figure of the week and shows serious private capital flowing into AI-driven materials discovery.
picks.title: Imperial expert leads science at £2 billion AI materials company CuspAI

picks.editorial_note: TUM and MIT's expanded AI/robotics partnership, with faculty exchanges funded by the Bavarian government, exemplifies deepening transatlantic academic collaboration on frontier robotics research.
picks.title: TUM and MIT are expanding their strategic partnership in the fields of AI and robotics. The Bavarian Ministry of Science is providing 1.6 million.

picks.editorial_note: A new deep-learning model revealing how 3D genome architecture differs in Alzheimer's patients is a genuine scientific result, not just a funding announcement, with direct implications for understanding neurodegenerative disease.
picks.title: AI, Single-Cell Technology Reveal How 3D Genome Differs in People With Alzheimer's Disease

picks.editorial_note: Penn State's $20 million NSF award to lead a national 'programmable cloud laboratory' node marks a concrete, large-dollar investment in automating scientific experimentation with AI.
picks.title: Penn State awarded $20M to lead an NSF ‘programmable cloud laboratory’ | Penn State University

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $83 million investment in AI-ready data infrastructure addresses a foundational bottleneck for AI-driven science across the entire U.S. research system, not just a single institution.
picks.title: NSF announces $83M investment in integrated data systems and services to advance AI-driven science and strengthen U.S. research infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: RIKEN's launch of AGIS to build generative AI foundation models and agents for science represents a major international counterpart to the U.S. Genesis Mission, signaling a global race in AI-for-science infrastructure.
picks.title: TRIP Headquarters Advanced General Intelligence for Science Program (AGIS)
